title: 皐月賞の後に・2つの可能性

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki dominates at the Satsuki Sho, but she's unsettled by an odd sensation in her legs after the race…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She suspects it has something to do with her distance aptitude, so she enlists the help of Agnes Tachyon to test out her hypothesis.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their findings reveal that Fuji Kiseki really is more suited to mile-long races than medium-length races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, she reports her discovery to me. The Japanese Derby and Kikuka Sho are longer races, but she relishes the challenge of running them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm torn between whether she should continue the Classic Triple Crown tour despite the difficulty, or switch to the mile tour, which would allow her to run at her very best…
